summary: Image-led trust page on a mix of light and dark grounds: split hero with an arch photo and one floating figure, two certification cards, a dark block of ten control tiles and a dark continuity split, ending on a full enquiry form. Needs two or three certifications, ten to twelve one-line controls and a continuity statement.

sections.note: small caps label, two-line heading and paragraph left; arch-cropped photo right with a dashed outline and a white card holding one figure and its label

centered label, heading and two lines; two large white cards side by side, each with a certificate badge top-left, a small pill with the standard name top-right, a title and three ticked statements separated by thin rules
label, heading and two paragraphs left; round photo right with a dashed ring and a white icon card over its edge
same dark ground continues: ten tiles in three columns (last row short), each a small tick icon, a two-line title and one sentence
round photo left with a small figure card; right a label, heading, two paragraphs, a bold lead-in and four ticked statements in dark boxes
centered label, heading and line with a thin dashed arc above; one white card with a twelve-field enquiry form (two columns, selects, message) and one orange button
